label: Syntax
raw_text: Recognize and compose coherent sentences that express complete thoughts.
child_texts: Distinguish between complete and incomplete simple sentences, and identify the sentence type (i.e., declarative, imperative, interrogative, and exclamatory). (I)
Use a variety of simple sentences (including a variety of sentence types) to develop clarity in written texts. (C)
Use singular and plural subjects with matching verbs. (C)
With adult support, use adjectives or adverbs to add details or clarify meaning. (C)
competency_statement: Recognize and create complete and clear sentences that express full thoughts using correct sentence types, subject-verb agreement, and descriptive words.
observable_behaviors: Identify whether a sentence is complete or incomplete.
Name the type of sentence as declarative, imperative, interrogative, or exclamatory.
Write simple sentences using different sentence types.
Use singular and plural subjects with matching verbs in sentences.
Add adjectives or adverbs to sentences to provide more detail or clarify meaning with adult support.
skill_clauses: Distinguish between complete and incomplete simple sentences and identify their types (declarative, imperative, interrogative, exclamatory).
Use a variety of simple sentences including different sentence types to make writing clear.
Use singular and plural subjects with matching verbs.
With adult support, use adjectives or adverbs to add details or clarify meaning.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify complete and incomplete sentences and sentence types.
student_actions.written_production: Write simple sentences using various sentence types and correct subject-verb agreement; add adjectives or adverbs with support.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort sentences by type and completeness.
student_actions.procedural_application: Use singular and plural subjects with matching verbs in writing; use adjectives or adverbs to add detail with support.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain the difference between complete and incomplete sentences and identify sentence types.
